dedupe_keys.name: qgis processing algorithm for residential building energy characterization

description: Jorge Rodriguez-Alvarez publishes a QGIS Processing Algorithm for residential building energy characterisation. Zenodo provides one public ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The description says the Python script selects residential polygons from an input layer and calculates construction year, gross floor area, estimated annual energy demand, dwelling count and energy-performance coefficient, then applies a predefined style. The processed layer can provide building-level inputs for district-energy or retrofit simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this QGIS algorithm. Coverage is whatever polygon inventory the user supplies, not a bundled national building register. A limitation is that the annual-demand estimate uses construction-period assumptions and may not match metered consumption; input field names and reference values must be checked before transferring to another region. The script was exported from QGIS 3.28.1, and compatibility with newer versions is untested here. No archive was downloaded and no energy attribute was recalculated.
